tokens.durgārtiharāṃ: remover of the affliction (ārti) of those in difficulty (durgā) — durgā-ārti-hara, acc. sg. f.
tokens.lakṣmīśamapi: also the Lord of Lakṣmī (lakṣmī-īśa = Viṣṇu) + api, acc. sg. m.
tokens.prapadye: I take refuge in / I resort to (1sg. pres. middle)

translations.close: I take refuge in Durgā, who removes the affliction of those in distress, and in Viriñca, and in Lakṣmī, and also in Lakṣmī's Lord.

tokens.mihirānivoditāṃstamomahāmohaharān: risen like suns, dispelling darkness and great delusion (mihira-iva-udita + tamas-mahā-moha-hara), acc. pl. m.
tokens.nato: bowed, prostrated (nata, ppp.), nom. sg. m.
tokens.smyaham: asmi + aham: 'I am — I' (with nataḥ: 'I bow')

translations.close: By their great majesty, risen like suns, dispelling darkness and the great delusion — I bow to them.

tokens.yāvatsāmarthyamālocya: having considered (ālocya) the capacity (sāmarthya) to the extent (yāvat) [possible], gerund
tokens.tantrapaddhatim: the Tantrapaddhati (this ritual manual), acc. sg. f.

translations.close: Having considered my capacity as far as it goes, I will compose the Tantrapaddhati.

tokens.ṛddhairvidhānamantrārthairvedyāṃ: to be known (vedyā) through successful (ṛddha) ritual prescriptions (vidhāna) and mantra-meanings (mantr-artha), acc. sg. f. + instr. pl.
tokens.śrutimivāparām: like (iva) another (aparā) Śruti (Veda), acc. sg. f.

translations.close: (It shall be) like another Śruti, to be known through efficacious prescriptions and mantra-meanings.

tokens.āṃ: f. acc. sg. ending (-ṇāṃ) [fragment of bahuguṇāṃ]
tokens.bhogavatīmiva: like the serpent-couch (bhogavatī, i.e. Śeṣa) + iva, acc. sg. f.

translations.close: Like the wonderful, many-qualitied serpent-couch (Śeṣa) of Viṣṇu.

tokens.sevyāṃ: to be served / waited upon, acc. sg. f.
tokens.kāmijanasyeṣṭāṃ: desired (iṣṭā) by people of passion (kāmi-janasya), acc. sg. f.
tokens.pramadāmiva: like a young woman (pramadā) + iva, acc. sg. f.

translations.close: Like a lovely young woman, to be served, desired by men of passion.

tokens.mantrabimbauṣadhidhyānairvidyāṃ: the lore (vidyā) [attained] through mantra, image, herb, and meditation (mantra-bimba-oṣadhi-dhyāna), acc. sg. f. + instr. pl.
tokens.sañjīvinīmiva: like the reviving (sañjīvinī, the life-restoring science) + iva, acc. sg. f.

translations.close: Like the reviving lore (sañjīvinī-vidyā), (attained) through mantras, images, herbs, and meditations.

tokens.ḍanītimivāparām: like another treatise on statecraft (daṇḍa-nītim iva aparām) [fragment]

translations.close: Like another treatise on polity (daṇḍanīti), (equipped) with means of suppression and execution.

tokens.satyabhāmāsamāśliṣṭāṃ: embraced (samāśliṣṭā) by Satyabhāmā, acc. sg. f.
tokens.mūrtiṃ: the form / image, acc. sg. f.
tokens.muradviṣaḥ: of the enemy of Mura (mura-dviṣ = Viṣṇu/Kṛṣṇa), gen. sg.

translations.close: Just as the form of Mura's foe (Kṛṣṇa) embraced by Satyabhāmā.

tokens.kṛtatretādikalpaiśca: and by kalpas beginning with the Kṛta and Tretā (ages) (kṛta-tretā-ādi-kalpa + ca), instr. pl.

translations.close: Just as the autumns of Brahmā, (counted) by kalpas beginning with the Kṛta and Tretā (ages).

tokens.yantrairdūrīkṛtānarthāṃ: whose misfortunes (anartha) have been removed (dūrīkṛta) by yantras, acc. sg. f.
tokens.durgabhūmimivāparām: like (iva) another (aparā) fortress-land (durga-bhūmi), acc. sg. f.

translations.close: Like a fortress-land whose dangers have been driven away by yantras.

tokens.kaliprasaṅgakaṭukāṃ: bitter (kaṭukā) through contact (prasaṅga) with the Kali (age), acc. sg. f.
tokens.kālasyeha: of Time here (kālasya + iha), gen. sg.
tokens.gatiryathā: as the course (gatiḥ) + yathā, acc./nom. sg. f.

translations.close: Like the course of Time here, made bitter by contact with the Kali age.

tokens.caturyugakramāyattāṃ: dependent (āyattā) on the sequence (krama, order) of the four ages (catur-yuga), acc. sg. f.
tokens.vaidhasīmiva: like that of Vidhi/Brahmā (vaidhasī) + iva, acc. sg. f.
tokens.kalpanām: the creation / cosmic ordering, acc. sg. f.

translations.close: Like the creation of Brahmā, dependent on the sequence of the four ages.

tokens.mūrtiṃ: the form / image, acc. sg. f.
tokens.vināyakasyeva: as of Vināyaka (Gaṇeśa) (vināyakasya + iva), gen. sg.
tokens.narākṛtim: having a human body (nara-ākṛti), acc. sg. f.

translations.close: Like the image of Vināyaka — elephant-faced, of human form.

tokens.tadvidāṃ: of those who know that (tad-vid), gen. pl.
tokens.pratyayāvedyāṃ: to be known with certainty (pratyaya-āvedya), acc. sg. f.
tokens.śaktimaiśvarīm: the sovereign Śakti (aiśvarī śakti, power of the Lord), acc. sg. f.

translations.close: The sovereign Śakti, liberation-granting, to be known with certainty by those who know it.

tokens.tattatkramāvedyāṃ: to be known through the sequence (krama, order) of this and that (tat-tat, the various procedures), acc. sg. f.
tokens.trayīmiva: like the triple Veda (trayī) + iva, acc. sg. f.

translations.close: Like the triple Veda, which accomplishes liberation and is to be known through the sequence of its various (procedures).

tokens.sacchandomunidigbandhāḥ: endowed with true meters (sat-chandas), bounded by the sages' directions (muni-dig-bandha), nom. pl. m.
tokens.sadhyānāḥ: together with meditation (sa-dhyāna), nom. pl. m.
tokens.saprayojanāḥ: with purpose / accompanied by their application (sa-prayojana), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: Possessing true meters, bounded by the sages' directions, accompanied by meditation, and purposeful.

tokens.bījamantrāśca: and the bīja-mantras (bīja-mantra + ca), nom. pl. m.
tokens.mālākhyamantrakāḥ: mantras called mālā ('garland') (mālā-ākhya-mantraka), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: The bījas, the bīja-mantras, and the mantras known as mālā-mantras.
Bīja-mantras (are those) below ten syllables; (full) mantras would be those below twenty.
For the most part, the bījas yield abundant success in childhood.

tokens.vārddhake: in old age, loc. sg. n.

translations.close: And even in old age, the mālā-mantras always succeed.

tokens.adharmitvaṃ: the state of possessing the property (-dharmitva) [fragment of mananatrāṇadharmitvaṃ]
tokens.vācake: in the signifier (vācaka, i.e. the mantra), loc. sg.

translations.close: But the property of thinking-and-protecting belongs to the signifier (the mantra) of the deity.

tokens.mantrarūpā: having the form of mantra (mantra-rūpā), nom. sg. f.

translations.close: For that Śakti, having the form of a mantra, is possessed of thinking-and-protecting.

tokens.vācyavācakayoraikyamadhigamya: having understood (adhigamya) the unity (aikya) of the signified and the signifier (vācya-vācakayoḥ), gerund
tokens.gurāvapi: even in the guru (gurau + api), loc. sg.

translations.close: Having grasped the unity of the signified and the signifier, even in the guru...

tokens.śabdānāṃ: of sounds / words, gen. pl. m.
tokens.mātṛkā: the Mātṛkā (the phonemic Mother-matrix, power embodied in letters), nom. sg. f.

translations.close: Indeed, the script (lipi) is the Mātṛkā of all mantras and of all sounds.

tokens.nirvikalpātmakaṃ: whose nature is free from conceptual construction (nirvikalpa-ātmaka), acc. sg. n.
tokens.yannityānandavigraham: which (yat) has eternal bliss as its body (nitya-ānanda-vigraha), acc. sg. n.

translations.close: Brahman, whose nature is without conceptual construction, which has eternal bliss as its body.

tokens.cirddhanaṃ: whose treasure is consciousness (cid-dhana; source reads cirddhana), acc. sg. n.
tokens.sarvagaṃ: going everywhere, all-pervading (sarva-ga), acc. sg. n.
tokens.ora: than the subtle (aṇoḥ, gen. of comparison) [fragment of tadaṇoraṇu]

translations.close: Exceedingly subtle, having consciousness as its treasure, pervasive, all-pervading — that (is) subtler than the subtle.

tokens.ādisargamukhe: at the beginning (mukhe) of the first creation (ādi-sarga), loc. sg.
tokens.jñānacikīrṣāyatnadhāra: the sustaining (dhāraṇa) of knowledge, will-to-make, and effort (jñāna-cikīrṣā-yatna-) [fragment of jñānacikīrṣāyatnadhāraṇāt]

translations.close: From the sustaining of knowledge, will, and effort at the outset of the first creation...

tokens.sattvaṃ: sattva (the principle of goodness/purity), nom. sg. n.
tokens.rajastamaścaitacchuklaraktāsitaprabham: and rajas and tamas — this (etat), having white, red, and black radiance (rajas-tamas + ca + etat + śukla-rakta-asita-prabham), nom. sg. n.

translations.close: Sattva, rajas, and tamas — this (triad) with white, red, and black radiance.

tokens.śaktirbindutāmeti: the Śakti attains the state of a bindu (śaktiḥ bindu-tām eti)
tokens.binduḥ: the bindu (the seed-point), nom. sg. m.

translations.close: That Śakti attains the state of a bindu; that bindu, too, becomes threefold.

tokens.avyaktāduditaṃ: arisen (udita) from the Unmanifest (avyaktāt), acc. sg. n.
tokens.mahānnāma: named the Great (mahān nāma), acc. sg. n.
tokens.tribhedakam: having three divisions (tri-bhedaka), acc. sg. n.

translations.close: From the Unmanifest arose the principle named the Great (Mahat), which has three divisions.

tokens.vaikārikastaijasaśca: the Vaikārika and the Taijasa (vaikārikaḥ taijasaḥ ca, first two forms of ahaṃkāra), nom. sg. m.
tokens.bhūtādiriti: and the Bhūtādi — thus (bhūtādi iti), nom. sg. m.
tokens.cāparaḥ: and the other (ca aparaḥ, the third), nom. sg. m.

translations.close: The Vaikārika, the Taijasa, and the Bhūtādi — thus the other one (the threefold ahaṃkāra).

tokens.sarvasiddhipradāyakam: bestowing all accomplishments (sarva-siddhi-pradāyaka), acc. sg. n.

translations.close: (The bindu is) liberation-granting, supreme, divine, bestowing every accomplishment.

tokens.samākhyātā: are declared / named (samākhyāta), nom. pl. f.
tokens.hyaṅgāni: verily the limbs (hi aṅgāni), nom. pl. n.

translations.close: The short (vowels) are declared to be Brahman; the long ones, verily, are the limbs of Ṣaṇmukha (the Six-Faced).

tokens.bindusaṃkṣobhādanantasyārthasiddhaye: from the agitation of the bindu (bindu-saṃkṣobhāt), for the accomplishment of the aims (artha-siddhaye) of the Infinite (anantasya)

translations.close: For the accomplishment of the aims of the Infinite One, (the universe) is born from the agitation of the bindu.

tokens.śaktirnādo: Śakti and Nāda (śaktiḥ nādaḥ), nom. sg. m.
tokens.mahāmāyā: Mahāmāyā (the Great Māyā), nom. sg. f.
tokens.vyometi: and Vyoman (space) — thus (vyoma iti), nom. sg. n.

translations.close: Śakti, Nāda, Mahāmāyā, and Vyoman — thus the fourfold (division).

tokens.vaikharī: Vaikharī (the fully articulated level of speech), nom. sg. f.
tokens.madhyamā: Madhyamā (the middle level), nom. sg. f.
tokens.sūkṣmayā: with the subtle one (sūkṣmā = Parā, the supreme level), instr. sg. f.

translations.close: Vaikharī, Madhyamā, and Paśyantī — and also the subtle (Parā).

tokens.sūkṣmā: the subtle one, nom. sg. f.
tokens.ḍalinīmadhye: in the middle of the Kuṇḍalinī (-ḍalinī-madhye) [fragment]
tokens.jyotirmātrātya: a measure of light, exceedingly (jyotir-mātrā-ati-) [fragment of jyotirmātrātyaṇīyasī]

translations.close: The subtle one (Parā), in the middle of the Kuṇḍalinī, is an exceedingly minute measure of light.

tokens.paśyantī: Paśyantī (the 'seeing' level of speech), nom. sg. f.
tokens.suṣumnāmāśritā: resting on (āśritā) the Suṣumnā (suṣumnām), nom. sg. f.

translations.close: Paśyantī is self-luminous; she abides in the Suṣumnā.

tokens.antaḥsañjalpamātrā: consisting only of inner articulation (antaḥ-sañjalpa-mātrā), nom. sg. f.

translations.close: She (Madhyamā) would be only inner articulation — undivided, moving upward.

tokens.jihvāmūloṣṭhaniṣṭyūtā: emitted / thrust forth at the root of the tongue and the lips (jihvā-mūla-oṣṭha-niṣṭyūta), nom. sg. f.
tokens.kṛtavar: having made the phonemes (kṛta-varṇa-) [fragment of kṛtavarṇaparigrahā]

translations.close: (Vaikharī is) thrust forth from the tongue-root and lips, having taken possession of the phonemes.

tokens.hakāraḥ: the letter ha, nom. sg. m.

translations.close: Then the letter ha, modified, was joined with repha (the letter r).

tokens.śaktibījaṃ: the Śakti-bīja (the seed-mantra of Śakti, i.e. HRĪM), nom. sg. n.
tokens.tadyogāt: from union with it (tad-yoga), abl. sg.
tokens.prapañcotpattikāra: the cause of the arising of the phenomenal world (prapañca-utpatti-kāraṇa-) [fragment of prapañcotpattikāraṇam]

translations.close: For the Śakti-bīja, through union with it, is the cause of the arising of the phenomenal world.

tokens.śliṣṭoccāritayoḥ: of the two uttered in close conjunction (śliṣṭa-uccārita), gen. dual
tokens.śābdaṃ: verbal, consisting of sound, acc. sg. n.
tokens.tadbījamīritam: that (tad) is declared (īrita) the bīja (bījam), acc. sg. n.

translations.close: When the two are uttered in coalescence, that sound-form is declared to be the bīja.

tokens.īkārastu: but the letter ī (īkāraḥ tu), nom. sg. m.

translations.close: The letter ī would be Māyā; the bindu is called Īśvara.

tokens.hakāro: the letter ha, nom. sg. m.
tokens.vyaktimāpanno: having attained manifestation (vyaktim āpannaḥ), nom. sg. m.
tokens.hārdaghoṣavivakṣitaḥ: intended to express the inner sound (hārda-ghoṣa-vivakṣita), nom. sg. m.

translations.close: The letter ha, having become manifest, is meant to convey the inner sound.

tokens.ūkārāntānyakārādīnyakṣarā: the phonemes beginning with a and ending with ū (ūkārāntāni akārādīni akṣarāṇi) [fragment of ūkārāntānyakārādīnyakṣarāṇi]
tokens.ṣaḍasya: its six (ṣaṭ asya), nom. pl. n.

translations.close: But its six phonemes, beginning with a and ending with ū...

tokens.īkārabhedatastvāsannekārādyakṣarā: but from the differentiation of ī, the phonemes beginning with e are adjacent (īkāra-bhedataḥ tu āsanna ekārādi akṣarāṇi) [fragment]

translations.close: But through the differentiation of the ī, the six syllables beginning with e are adjacent.

tokens.śaktyaṅgatvāt: because of being limbs of Śakti (śakti-aṅgatva), abl. sg.
tokens.syuramṛtāṃśukalātmakāḥ: would be (syuḥ) having the nature of the digits of the immortal-rayed (amṛtāṃśu = moon) (kalā-ātmaka), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: Because they are members of Śakti, they would be kalās, of the nature of the digits of the immortal-rayed (moon).

tokens.dīrghasvarā: the long vowels (dīrgha-svara), nom. pl. m.
tokens.visargāntāḥ: ending in visarga (the emission-mark 'ḥ') (visarga-anta), nom. pl. m.
tokens.strīliṅgāḥ: feminine in gender (strī-liṅga), nom. pl. m.
tokens.somarūpi: having the form of Soma (soma-rūpi-) [fragment of somarūpiṇaḥ]

translations.close: The long vowels, ending in visarga, are feminine and of Soma's (lunar) form.

tokens.āmudayādyaṃ: the first emergence (-ṇām udaya-ādyaṃ) [fragment of svarāṇāmudayādyaṃ]

translations.close: But the first arising of the vowels is written here at the beginning.

tokens.sparśagu: having touch as its quality (sparśa-guṇa-) [fragment of sparśaguṇo]
tokens.sparśākhyāḥ: called sparśa ('touch', i.e. stops) (sparśa-ākhya), nom. pl. m.
tokens.kādayo: the (consonants) beginning with ka (kādayaḥ), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: From space (arose) wind, whose quality is touch; the consonants beginning with ka, called sparśas, came into being.

tokens.yādyakṣaracatuṣkaṃ: the group of four phonemes beginning with ya (yādi-akṣara-catuṣka), nom. sg. n.
tokens.vāyvagnikṣmāmbhasāṃ: of wind, fire, earth, and water (vāyu-agni-kṣmā-ambhas), gen. pl.

translations.close: But the four phonemes beginning with ya are the body of wind, fire, earth, and water.

tokens.śeṣāstu: but the rest (śeṣāḥ tu), nom. pl. m.
tokens.śādyāḥ: beginning with śa (śādi, i.e. the remaining letters śa…ha), nom. pl. m.
tokens.sāgnīṣomāḥ: endowed with Agni and Soma (sa-agni-ṣoma), nom. pl. m.
tokens.svaraspṛśaḥ: touching the vowels (svara-spṛś), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: But the rest, beginning with śa, are pervasive, endowed with Agni and Soma, in contact with the vowels.

tokens.kādayaḥ: the (group) beginning with ka, nom. pl. m.
tokens.yādayaḥ: the (group) beginning with ya, nom. pl. m.
tokens.śādayastathā: likewise the (group) beginning with śa (śādayaḥ tathā)

translations.close: The ka-group (numbers) twenty-five phonemes; likewise the ya-group and the śa-group.

tokens.akārādisvarairyuktahalāṃ: the consonants joined with the vowels beginning with a (akārādi-svaraiḥ yukta-hal), acc. sg. f.

translations.close: And (the count arises from) the consonants joined with the vowels beginning with a, and also from their mutual combination.

tokens.saiva: that very (sā eva), nom. sg. f.
tokens.tāro: the Tāra (tāraḥ, the praṇava OM), nom. sg. m.
tokens.vāgbhavamityapi: and the Vāgbhava — thus too (vāgbhavam iti api), acc. sg. n.

translations.close: That very Śakti has become twofold: the Tāra and the Vāgbhava.

tokens.śabdabrahmātmako: having the nature of Sound-Brahman (śabda-brahma-ātmaka), nom. sg. m.

translations.close: This praṇava, called Tāra, is held to be of the nature of Sound-Brahman.

tokens.viśvavāgbhūtidaṃ: bestowing all speech and prosperity (viśva-vāk-bhūti-da), acc. sg. n.
tokens.vāgīśvaryāstanurbhavet: would be the body (tanuḥ) of Vāgīśvarī (vāgīśvaryāḥ), 3sg. opt.

translations.close: And that, which bestows all speech and prosperity, would be the body of Vāgīśvarī.
The Śakti-bīja, then the Tāra, then the Vāgbhava, and thereafter...

tokens.tadbhedajāśca: and born from their differentiation (tad-bheda-ja + ca), nom. pl. f.
tokens.vāco: the utterances / speech (vācaḥ), nom. pl. f.
tokens.deśabhājā: by division of place (deśa-bhājā, i.e. articulatory position), instr. sg. f.

translations.close: And the utterances born from their differentiation, which are distinguished by (articulatory) place.

tokens.ākāśādīni: beginning with space (ākāśa-ādi), nom. pl. n.

translations.close: The elements beginning with space, the tanmātras, and the sense-organs...

tokens.bahunā: with much (bahunā, i.e. much prattle), instr. sg. n.
tokens.pralāpena: with prattle / chatter, instr. sg. m.
tokens.śabdārthātmako: having the nature of word and meaning (śabda-artha-ātmaka), nom. sg. m.

translations.close: What (need) of much prattle — (that) which is the whole, of the nature of word and meaning?

tokens.lipitvaṃ: the state of being script (lipi-tva), acc. sg. n.

translations.close: And in this (system) called the Mātṛkā, the property of being script is written, because...

tokens.atvamamṛtātmatvādar: the phoneme-ness and the immortal-nature (arṇatvam amṛtātmatvāt) [fragment]

translations.close: Because the phoneme is called 'water' (ambhas) owing to its being a phoneme and owing to its immortal nature.

tokens.upādānāni: the material causes (upādāna), nom. pl. n.
tokens.viśvātmamātṛkāyāstu: but of the Mātṛkā whose self is the universe (viśva-ātma-mātṛkāyāḥ tu), gen. sg. f.

translations.close: But the material causes of the Mātṛkā, whose self is the universe, are indeed five.

tokens.ṭatavargau: the ṭa-group and the ta-group (ṭa-ta-varga), nom. dual m.
tokens.pādau: the two feet (pāda), nom. dual m.
tokens.pārśvayugmaṃ: the pair of sides (pārśva-yugma), nom. sg. n.
tokens.paphau: pa and pha (paphau), nom. dual m.

translations.close: The ṭa- and ta-groups are the two feet; pa and pha, likewise, are the pair of flanks — so they are held.

tokens.tvagasṛṅmāṃsamedosthimajjāśuklāni: skin, blood, flesh, fat, bone, marrow, (and) semen (tvag-asṛk-māṃsa-medas-astthi-majjā-śukla), nom. pl. n.
tokens.yādayaḥ: the (group) beginning with ya, nom. pl. m.

translations.close: The ya-group (are) skin, blood, flesh, fat, bone, marrow, and semen.

tokens.sphūrtiḥ: the throb / flash of manifestation (sphūrti), nom. sg. f.
tokens.kṣakāraḥ: the letter kṣa, nom. sg. m.
tokens.viśvalokamayī: consisting of the whole world (viśva-loka-mayī), nom. sg. f.

translations.close: The letter kṣa is the pulsation, together with wrath; (it is) the body consisting of the whole world.

tokens.brahmādistambaparyantaṃ: from Brahmā down to a clump of grass (brahmādi-stamba-paryanta), acc. sg. n.
tokens.mātṛkāyāṃ: in the Mātṛkā, loc. sg. f.

translations.close: Everything from Brahmā up to a blade of grass is established in the Mātṛkā.

tokens.avargādudgataḥ: risen from the a-group (avarga-udgata), nom. sg. m.
tokens.bhūsutaḥ: the son of Earth (bhū-suta = Mars), nom. sg. m.

translations.close: From the a-group has risen the Sun; from the ka-group, the son of Earth (Mars).

tokens.śaniścandro: Saturn and the Moon (śaniḥ candraḥ), nom. sg. m.

translations.close: From the pa-group, Saturn and the Moon; from the ya-group arose the omnipresent (Vibhu).

tokens.mātṛkākṣarasambhedāt: from the differentiation of the Mātṛkā's phonemes (mātṛkā-akṣara-sambheda), abl. sg.
tokens.kathyante: they are spoken / declared (3pl. pres. passive)

translations.close: From the differentiation of the Mātṛkā's phonemes, (the following) are indeed declared below, here.

tokens.samudgatāstathā: likewise emerged (samudgatāḥ tathā), nom. pl. f.
tokens.rudraśaktayastatprasaṃkhyayā: the Rudra-Śaktis, by that enumeration (rudra-śaktayaḥ tat-prasaṃkhyayā), nom. pl. f.

translations.close: Likewise have emerged the Rudra-Śaktis, according to that enumeration.

tokens.oṣadhyaścāpi: and also the herbs (oṣadhyaḥ ca api), nom. pl. f.

translations.close: And the herbs — fifty — and the kalās, thirty-eight, likewise.

tokens.mātṛkotpattirāgamoktā: the origin of the Mātṛkā as declared in the Āgama (mātṛkā-utpattiḥ āgama-uktā), nom. sg. f.
tokens.pradarśitā: has been shown (pradarśita, ppp.), nom. sg. f.

translations.close: Thus has been shown the origin of the Mātṛkā, as declared in the Āgama.

tokens.atroddhriyante: here are extracted / drawn out (atra + uddhriyante, 3pl. pres. passive)
tokens.samantrakāḥ: together with their mantras (sa-mantraka), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: Here are extracted the bījas — the bīja-mantras together with their (full) mantras.

tokens.yathāpāṭhaṃ: according to the reading / as in the text (yathā-pāṭham)
tokens.vijñeyā: to be known (vijñeya), nom. pl. f.

translations.close: Thereafter they are to be known clearly by the expert, according to the text.

tokens.bhagavacchabdasaṃyutāḥ: joined with the word 'bhagavat' (bhagavat-śabda-saṃyuta), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: Here they are written as appropriate, joined with the word 'Lord' (bhagavat).

tokens.sargo: the emission (sargaḥ — here the visarga), nom. sg. m.
tokens.bindudvaye: in the pair of bindus (bindu-dvaya), loc. sg.

translations.close: The bindu would be a staff (with) a half-moon; the visarga is held (to consist of) the two bindus.

tokens.viṣakālau: poison and Time (viṣa-kāla), nom. dual m.
tokens.makāraḥ: the letter ma, nom. sg. m.
tokens.dhātavo: the (bodily) elements / constituents (dhātavaḥ), nom. pl. m.
tokens.yādayo: the (group) beginning with ya (yādayaḥ), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: The letter ma would be poison and Time; the ya-group are held to be the bodily elements.

tokens.khaḥ: the letter kha, nom. sg. m.
tokens.abhuvaneśākhyo: -bhuvaneśākhyaḥ, called the lord of the (vital) worlds [fragment]
tokens.hakāraḥ: the letter ha, nom. sg. m.

translations.close: Kha is called the lord of the vital worlds; ha is denominated Śiva.

tokens.paphabāśca: and pa, pha, ba (pa-pha-ba + ca), nom. pl. m.
tokens.bhamakṣāśca: and bha, ma, kṣa (bha-ma-kṣa + ca), nom. pl. m.
tokens.trayastrayaḥ: three and three (trayas trayas), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: And (the sets) pa-pha-ba and bha-ma-kṣa — those (groups of) three and three undergo interchange.

tokens.svareṣu: in the vowels, loc. pl. m.
tokens.yuktākṣareṣvapi: also in the conjunct phonemes (yuktākṣareṣu api), loc. pl.

translations.close: Interchange is not approved among the vowels, nor likewise among the conjunct phonemes.

tokens.tattadakṣaravijñaptyai: for the making-known of this-and-that phoneme (tat-tad-akṣara-vijñapti), dat. sg.

translations.close: For they serve as a convention for signalling each particular phoneme.
Correspondingly, one should know: the vowels are seven, the directions ten.

tokens.vedāścatvāra: the Vedas, four (vedāḥ catvāraḥ), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: The Vedas are indeed four; three are the Rāmas; three are the fires.

tokens.uktātyuktā: Uktā and Atyuktā (uktā atyuktā, meter names), nom. sg. f.

translations.close: Uktā, Atyuktā, and likewise Madhyā, Pratiṣṭhā, Supratiṣṭhitā.
And Triṣṭubh, and likewise Jagatī; after that, Atijagatī is recognized.

tokens.dhṛtiścātidhṛtiścaiva: Dhṛti and Atidhṛti (dhṛtiḥ ca atidhṛtiḥ ca eva, meter names), nom. sg. f.
tokens.prakṛtirākṛtiḥ: Prakṛti and Ākṛti (prakṛtiḥ ākṛtiḥ, meter names), nom. sg. f.

translations.close: Dhṛti, and Atidhṛti, Kṛti, Prakṛti, Ākṛti.

tokens.chandasāṃ: of the meters (chandas), gen. pl. n.

translations.close: The count of these meters is prescribed here somewhere.

tokens.tattvāni: the tattvas / principles, nom. pl. n.

translations.close: Likewise, in the Śaiva (system), the tattvas would be thirty-six in number.

tokens.navabhirnavapañcāṣṭavar: by nines, by (groups of) nine, five, (and) eight phonemes (navabhiḥ nava-pañca-aṣṭa-varṇa-) [fragment of navabhirnavapañcāṣṭavarṇaiḥ]

translations.close: Or the count here could be by nines — by (groups of) nine, five, and eight phonemes.

tokens.hyarthānāṃ: for of the meanings (hi + arthānām), gen. pl. m.
tokens.bhavatyeveṣṭasiddhaye: indeed becomes, for the accomplishment of the desired (bhavati eva iṣṭa-siddhaye)

translations.close: For easy comprehension of the meanings indeed serves the accomplishment of what is desired.

tokens.tacchāktaṃ: that Śākta (tat śākta, belonging to Śakti), acc. sg. n.
tokens.avākhyabījamakhilaṃ: -ṇavākhya-bījam, the seed called praṇava, the whole (akhilam) [fragment]

translations.close: They know that Śākta seed called the Praṇava — the whole (world) — as a banyan seed.

tokens.śrīmadīśānaśivagurudevamiśraviracite: composed by the revered Īśānaśivagurudevamiśra (śrīmat-īśāna-śiva-gurudeva-miśra-viracita), loc. sg. n.
tokens.tantrasārapaddhatau: in the Tantrasārapaddhati, loc. sg. f.
tokens.vastunirdeśamātṛkopapattinir: the determination (nirṇaya) of the genesis (upapatti) of the Mātṛkā in the exposition of the subject-matter (vastu-nirdeśa-mātṛkā-upapatti-nirṇaya-) [fragment of vastunirdeśamātṛkopapattinirṇayo]

translations.close: Thus, in the Tantrasārapaddhati composed by the revered Īśānaśivagurudevamiśra, (this is) the first chapter named 'The Determination of the Genesis of the Mātṛkā in the Exposition of the Subject-Matter'.

tokens.aśvīśo: Aśvīśa (the Lord of the Horses), nom. sg. m.
tokens.bhārabhūtiśca: and Bhārabhūti (bhāra-bhūtiḥ ca), nom. sg. m.
tokens.tithīśaḥ: Tithīśa (the Lord of the lunar days), nom. sg. m.

translations.close: Aśvīśa, Bhārabhūti, Tithīśa, Sthāṇuka, Hara.

tokens.akrūraśca: and Akrūra (akrūraḥ ca), nom. sg. m.
tokens.ṣoḍaśaite: these sixteen (ṣoḍaśa ete), nom. pl. m.
tokens.svareśvarāḥ: the lords of the vowels (svara-īśvara), nom. pl. m.

translations.close: And Akrūra and Mahāsena — these sixteen are the lords of the vowels.

tokens.ekarudraśca: and Ekarudra (eka-rudraḥ ca), nom. sg. m.
tokens.kūrmaikanetrau: Kūrma and Ekanetra (kūrma-ekanetrau), nom. dual m.

translations.close: And Ekarudra, Kūrma and Ekanetra (the two), and Caturānana.

tokens.ardhanārīśvaraścomākāntaścāṣaḍiḍi: and Ardhanārīśvara, and Umākānta, and the two Ṣaḍiḍiṇḍin (ardhanārīśvaraḥ ca umākāntaḥ ca ṣaḍiḍiṇḍin-) [fragment of ardhanārīśvaraścomākāntaścāṣaḍiḍiṇḍinau]

translations.close: And Ardhanārīśvara, and Umākānta, and the two Ṣaḍiḍiṇḍins.
